title: Coming Down
logline: On the last morning of a silent retreat, a room of strangers who have not spoken for days says its first ordinary words, packs, and travels back together toward a city none of them have seen in a week.
human_question: What does it take to come back into a crowded world after time spent putting it down?

situation.what_happens: A lay retreat ends. Silence is formally released, people speak, pack and say goodbye to strangers they have lived beside without speaking, and then travel back into ordinary noise. The re-entry, not the retreat, is the event: people notice traffic, phones, conversation and their own reactions to all three, and most of them will be back at work the next day.
situation.who_is_involved: The retreatants, who are laypeople with jobs and families; whoever runs and teaches the retreat; the families collecting people at the other end.
situation.what_is_at_stake: For participants: privacy about why they came, and the ordinary disappointment of watching a week's quiet evaporate within hours. For the centre: its rules and its participants' trust.
situation.how_it_unfolds: The last morning follows a fixed schedule, and the release of silence is a scheduled act rather than a breakthrough. Pressure comes from transport, from the abruptness of speech returning, and from people reaching for words about something they may not want to describe. It ends when everyone is back in ordinary life, and reality decides what anyone is willing to say about it.

concept_merge.why_together: C097 (the seven purifications) contributes the largest map the group works with, from purity of conduct to the knowledge and vision of the path, and the fact that its lay form is not a permanent withdrawal: laypeople keep their precepts by taking them up again and again [C097-M:L10]. C100 (path and fruition processes) contributes the reviewing that the texts place after the decisive moment, looking back at what was gained and what remains. C085 (the compendium of meditation subjects) contributes the fact that the people in one silent room were not all doing the same thing [C085-P:L47].
concept_merge.what_it_reveals: Together they show that the map's end is not a departure from ordinary life but a return to it, repeatedly, and that the variety of practice folds back into one shared journey home. C097 alone would be a diagram; the retreat alone would be a lifestyle film.

concept_links.why: The seven purifications run from conduct to knowledge and vision [C097-M:L3], and the source's own lay ending is ordinary and repeatable: laypeople keep the precepts by retaking them again and again [C097-M:L10]. The digest warns the sequence is not a seven-step wellbeing ladder and that most of its detail is written for monastics, so the film uses the shape and the lay ending only.

The texts place a reviewing after the decisive moment, looking back over what changed and what remains, and the digest warns that this is not journaling or goal-tracking. Participants' own quiet reflections can carry the human shape without any doctrinal claim.

The forty subjects are matched to the person, so one silent room holds several different practices [C085-P:L47]. The film does not itemise them; it shows the variety folding back into one shared departure.

what_the_viewer_could_understand: In the texts the road does not end in permanent withdrawal for laypeople: they take their commitments up again and again, in ordinary life, which is exactly where a retreat puts everyone back.
what_must_be_real: A real retreat, its real schedule and its real participants, filmed with the centre's permission and each person's consent. Neither the end of silence nor anyone's first words are staged, and no participant is presented as having attained anything.
position_hint: closing candidate: a collective route to the group's required closing event, in which the film is set down among a crowd, the planned shared image with Episode 1 and Episode 100.
risks: Overlapping with Episode 1's monastery material; this must stay a lay retreat, not a forest hermitage
Centres may forbid filming near a silent period
Implying any participant has attained anything
drop_if: No centre will permit filming even at the edges of a silent period
Participants are unwilling to be shown, which is likely and legitimate

connections.note: A different route to the same required closing event: a group's return into the world, or one person's final letting go.
One day's class matching many people to many objects, against one retreat's shared ending.

selection.reason: Held as the standing alternative for the final film if the elder's film cannot be made; it is also the group's fullest treatment of C097.

unknowns: No participant or event has been found or confirmed. Everything here is a research direction.
evidence_class_note: Editorial proposal. No location, scene or shot decisions are made at the idea stage.
